presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No horns, no markings, no blush.
presets.description: Three optional components off at once. The body silhouette and the face are what is left, and the style ships nineteen mouths and nineteen eye arrangements to fill that.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: One warm brown ramp, ground included.
presets.description: Four mouth variants are excluded here. They show a pink tongue painted straight into the artwork, where no color option reaches it.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue on body, markings or ground.
presets.description: Flat shapes with a hard shadow, which is the kind of drawing that survives losing color. Same mouth exclusion as Sepia.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One mint critter on one deep green.
presets.description: A single body color across a whole set, so nothing but the silhouette and the face separates two of them. The markings stay a shade apart, because the style requires them to differ from the body.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style ships twelve bodies at candy brightness. These are the same creatures in tones that hold still, which suits a list where a dozen appear at once. The tongue mouths are excluded, the same ones the monochrome presets drop, because their pink is painted in rather than picked.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Bodies past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same lever the other way. The ground stays near-black so the creature is the only lit thing on the tile.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: Every background the style ships is dark and saturated. Pale ones turn the same creature from a spotlit specimen into a sticker.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.summary: Saturated ground behind a pale creature.
presets.description: Louder than the shipped set and pushed toward the primaries. The bodies are pale, so they keep their edge on top of it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The body palette is light already, so nothing else has to move for the creature to stay visible.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the creature.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Horns, markings and blush on everyone.
presets.description: All three optional components turned up. The style ships fifteen head pieces and ten body markings, and at the default probabilities most seeds never reach them.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The style ships an animation component that is off by default. The `animation` tag switches it on and lets the seed pick a speed. It respects prefers-reduced-motion.
